arguments.claim: Post-merger integration still weighing on ROA/ROE trajectory; any negative surprise on credit costs or deposit cost pressure in upcoming Q1 results could invalidate broker targets and trigger correction from stretched technical levels.

Weak deal TCV commentary and broad IT sector downgrades cast doubt on revenue visibility; AI-driven productivity narrative may compress billing rates and margins, making current valuations vulnerable to any cut.
Technical breakout on heavy volumes often sees mean-reversion pullback within 5-10 days; chasing momentum here increases drawdown risk if broader market risk-off occurs.
Catalyst is broker accumulation call rather than fundamental improvement; such catalysts lose potency quickly when headline IT earnings miss Street estimates.
